meta_title: OpenTranslate — Free, private full-page translation for Safari on Mac & iPhone
meta_description: OpenTranslate is a free, open-source Safari Web Extension for macOS and iOS/iPadOS that translates any web page in full — with ~32 providers including free Google & Microsoft, DeepL, and 28 LLM engines. No account, no cloud sync, zero telemetry.
og_title: OpenTranslate — Free, private full-page translation for Safari
og_description: Full-page translation for Safari on Mac, iPhone & iPad. ~32 providers, bilingual or translation-only view. No account, no cloud sync, zero telemetry. Free & open source.
twitter_description: Full-page translation for Safari on Mac, iPhone & iPad. ~32 providers, bilingual view, no account, zero telemetry. Free & open source.
jsonld_description: A free, open-source Safari Web Extension for full-page translation on macOS and iOS/iPadOS. Supports ~32 translation providers including free Google & Microsoft, DeepL, and 28 LLM engines. Bilingual or translation-only in-page rendering. No account, no cloud sync, no telemetry.
banner: This site is also available in English.
hero_badge: Free & open source · Safari on iPhone & iPad
hero_h1:
Read the whole web,
right on your iPhone.
hero_p1: A full-page translator for Safari on iPhone and iPad that picks up where the built-in one leaves off — so a Finnish news article reads cleanly in English on your phone, not a garbled half-translation. Works on Mac too.
hero_p2: Choose from ~32 engines — free Google & Microsoft, DeepL, or your own LLM. Bilingual or translation-only. Everything runs locally.
phone_target_text: The weather is beautiful and sunny today, and many are heading to the beach to enjoy the warmth. The sea has already warmed to almost eighteen degrees.
providers_caption: Powered by the engines you already trust — or bring your own
how_h2: Three steps to a readable page
how_1_p: Add OpenTranslate to Safari on your Mac, iPhone or iPad and enable it for the sites you read.
how_2_p: Start free with Google or Microsoft, or paste an API key for DeepL or any of 28 LLM engines.
how_3_p: Tap the popup on any page. Read the translation on its own, or side-by-side with the original.
feat_h2: Everything you need to read the whole web
feat_sub: A serious translation engine wrapped in a native Safari extension.
feat_1_p: Free Google & Microsoft engines, DeepL / DeepLX, plus 28 LLM providers via the Vercel AI SDK. Switch anytime.
feat_2_p: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama and more — your keys, your models, your bill.
feat_3_p: Render the translation in place, or keep the original alongside it to check the source as you read.
feat_4_p: A one-tap popup for quick control, and a complete settings page to fine-tune providers, languages and rendering.
feat_5_h: Native to Safari on iPhone & iPad
feat_5_p: A real Safari Web Extension for iOS / iPadOS — and macOS too. Not a wrapper. It behaves the way you expect.
feat_6_p: GPL-3.0-or-later. Read every line, build it yourself, or contribute. No paywall, no lock-in, ever.
priv_p: Your settings, keys and language preferences live on your device and only your device. When you translate, the page text goes straight to the provider you chose — never through us, because there is no us to go through.
priv_1_p: No sign-up, no email, no login wall.
priv_2_p: Settings stored locally on each device.
priv_3_p: No analytics, no tracking, no beacons.
dl_p: Grab the latest build from GitHub Releases. A Mac / iOS App Store listing is on the way.
bmc_note: Built and maintained by one solo developer. Free forever — a coffee keeps it going.
foot_attrib: Based on read-frog by Mengxi Ream and contributors (also GPL-3.0-or-later). OpenTranslate adapts it into a focused Safari translator for macOS & iOS.
